_comment: One farm, three readers that must agree (plan step 3.2, gd-DxFIK7tips). GET /api/lands/{land}/purse reads it from beads (cmd/beads-viewer TestLandPurseAPI_CreditsCrossCheck); the controller exports gardenio_lands_credit_rate and gardenio_lands_credits_granted from the same beads (internal/metrics TestCollectLandCredits_CrossCheck); the vmalert rules turn those and the account gauge into credits (helm/gardenio/tests TestLandsCredits_PurseCrossCheck). Every want is the purse's figure. No agent is running, so in-flight is 0 and the purse's remaining equals the rules' settled remaining. Figures are multiples of 0.25 so they are exact in binary.
